ideas.topic: The Hidden Symbolism of Ancient Egyptian Jewelry
ideas.hook: This golden amulet wasn't just decoration; it was designed to physically protect the wearer from bad luck in the afterlife.
ideas.why: It mirrors the 'Objects from tombs' success pattern by focusing on tangible, mysterious artifacts that promise expert-level insight into daily life.

ideas.topic: Why Ancient Egyptian Ink Never Fades
ideas.hook: We've been writing for thousands of years, yet ancient Egyptian papyrus ink is still perfectly black—how did they do it?
ideas.why: This addresses the 'Science of the ancients' niche, tapping into the curiosity-driven appeal of lost technologies similar to the viral 'Ancient Air Conditioning' video.

ideas.topic: The Truth Behind the 'Cursed' Burial Chambers
